Use case: style-transfer.
Input 1 is the PRIMARY DRAWING-STYLE AUTHORITY: the blue-haired anime whale maid. Input 2 is ONLY the empty room's architecture/camera reference, NOT its rendering style.
Redraw the completely EMPTY room from input 2 in EXACTLY THE SAME visual language as the anime girl in input 1. This must look painted by the SAME character artist for the SAME 2D game, not a realistic background pasted behind a cartoon.
STYLE REQUIREMENTS: clean visible blue-brown ink outlines of controlled medium weight around wall edges, window frames, baseboards and floor planks; soft flat pastel base colors; two or three broad deliberate cel-shadow shapes; restrained gentle gradient only inside a few shadow regions; stylized simplified wood without photographic grain; smooth matte surfaces without microtexture; elegant rounded anime proportions. Palette coordinated with her navy, cornflower/cyan, ivory and restrained gold: ivory walls with subtle powder-blue shadow, pale honey wood, warm cream sunlight, distant simplified blue sea and sky through the window. NO photorealism, no 3D rendering, no photographic texture, no glossy physically based reflection, no noisy brushwork, no realistic cinematic lighting. Avoid oversimplified flat vector clip art; retain refined anime linework and a beautiful polished visual-novel illustration.
STRUCTURE: same wide 16:9 camera, slightly elevated mostly frontal studio-room view, same back/side walls, big central back window, continuous clear plank floor. Keep the floor broad and walkable. Empty architecture ONLY. No furniture, no curtains, no rugs, no lamps, no plants, no pictures or wall decor, no people, no characters, no UI, no writing.
Deliver one high-resolution finished clean anime room wallpaper, maximum available native resolution. The blue-haired character is a style reference and must NOT appear in the wallpaper.

Use case: lighting-weather. Input 1 is the anime character STYLE authority; input 2 is the EMPTY ROOM edit target. Make a NIGHT version of exactly this empty anime room. Preserve every camera angle, architectural outline, window position, plank line and dimension. Keep clean visible anime ink contours and broad cel-shadow colors identical in drawing technique to the character. Change only the time of day: deep blue sea and starry indigo sky outside the window, a small moon, gentle blue-lavender moonlight on the floor, soft subtle warm ambient fill so the empty room remains readable and cozy. No realistic material texture or photography. NO furniture, curtains, rugs, lamps, plants, decor, people, characters, UI or text. Wide 16:9 maximum native resolution. The room must remain completely empty, suitable as a switchable independent wallpaper.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is the APPROVED UPRIGHT SIDE MODEL of DS girl wearing the CASUAL blue jacket and ivory dress. Create ONE production texture atlas of SEPARATE CLEAN 2D SKELETAL PARTS matching this character exactly. Square image, maximum native resolution (2048x2048 preferred), 4 columns × 4 rows. Each of the 16 parts is CROP-CENTERED in its own grid cell with generous alpha padding, no part crosses a cell border. Parts can be different scales; registration will be done in code. Do not include any assembled character.
Row 1, left to right: (1) back hair ONLY, long blue-to-cyan curls with ear/side bow, no face; (2) navy whale tail ONLY, no dress; (3) FAR UPPER SLEEVE ONLY from shoulder to elbow, ends PLAIN at elbow with overlap, NO cuff or hand; (4) FAR FOREARM SLEEVE from elbow down to white cuff and relaxed hand, NO shoulder.
Row 2: (5) FAR THIGH white-tights segment ONLY hip to knee, straight vertical, no shin/ankle/foot; (6) FAR SHIN white-tights segment ONLY knee to ankle, straight vertical, no thigh or shoe; (7) FAR SHOE, strict side profile pointing RIGHT, flat horizontal sole; (8) TORSO GARMENT ONLY including neck, collar, fitted blue jacket front/back and ivory bodice to waist, with EMPTY ARMHOLES and NO arms/sleeves/hands/skirt.
Row 3: (9) NEAR THIGH white-tights segment ONLY hip to knee straight vertical; (10) NEAR SHIN white-tights segment ONLY knee to ankle straight vertical; (11) NEAR SHOE strict side profile pointing RIGHT, flat sole identical anatomy to far shoe; (12) IVORY SKIRT ONLY waist to ruffled hem, side-profile volume, whale embroidery, no legs or torso.
Row 4: (13) NEAR UPPER SLEEVE shoulder to elbow ends PLAIN with overlap NO cuff/hand; (14) NEAR FOREARM SLEEVE elbow to white cuff and hand, no shoulder; (15) HEAD with closed-mouth right-facing face, blue eyes, blue hair cap AND bangs/ahoge, no neck/body; (16) ONE SMALL separate blue front lock of hair, no face, no eyes, no duplicate ahoge.
Every joint end must include smoothly rounded painted overlap extending under its neighboring segment. No hollow cut ends or exposed interior cross-sections. Natural human limb shapes and proportions, NO bent knees, no full legs where only thighs requested. Preserve elegant visible anime outlines, soft cel color, same palette and original outfit. Genuinely transparent alpha surroundings and padding. NO ground, glow, shadow, opaque background, grid lines, labels, typography, anatomy diagram, extra limbs, full characters, cuff on upper arms, sleeves on torso, or shoes facing left.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE clean production 2D skeletal PARTS ATLAS of this exact DS whale girl in CASUAL clothes. Input 1 is the approved neutral model: match its upright natural anatomy, proportions, blue jacket, ivory dress, white tights, blue shoes, linework and soft cel painting. Input 2 supplies the specified viewing direction only; do NOT copy its walking pose. 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 isolated crop-centered parts with generous genuinely transparent padding, maximum available native resolution (2048 square preferred). Never draw a complete assembled figure. No text, labels, grid, shadows, glow or background. Each part must stay inside its cell. Smooth closed joint overlap areas, no hollow cross-sections.
Cells left-to-right row-by-row: 1 back hair only; 2 navy whale tail only; 3 left upper sleeve shoulder-to-elbow, plain elbow end NO cuff or hand; 4 left forearm sleeve elbow-to-white cuff and relaxed hand, NO shoulder; 5 left thigh in white tights hip-to-knee ONLY; 6 left shin white tights knee-to-ankle ONLY; 7 left shoe flat neutral sole; 8 torso clothing with neck and collar and jacket/bodice to waist, EMPTY ARMHOLES, NO arms/sleeves/skirt; 9 right thigh hip-to-knee ONLY; 10 right shin knee-to-ankle ONLY; 11 right flat shoe; 12 ivory ruffled skirt only waist-to-hem; 13 right upper sleeve shoulder-to-elbow ONLY no cuff/hand; 14 right forearm with cuff/hand ONLY no shoulder; 15 head with blue hair cap and ahoge; 16 small extra front hair locks ONLY no face or duplicate ahoge.
ALL limb bones in upright neutral alignment, no stepping, no bent knees. Upper sleeves contain no hands/cuffs, torso contains no sleeves, thighs contain no shins. The same parts will be assembled and animated by bones in a 2D game. Preserve refined anime outlines and DS whale embroidery. EVERY PART is viewed straight from the FRONT. Head faces viewer with both blue eyes and SMALL CLOSED MOUTH. White-tights left/right legs straight and symmetric with identical anatomy. Shoes show front toe caps; soles share horizontal ground. Front torso has blue jacket opening and ivory bodice.
